text:
Nora: Heads up 5; an IC asked if we can do a mid-quarter leveling + comp change. What's the short path?

Sam (People Ops): Yes possible. If salary or equity changes are included, use the comp-change form. Title-only -> title update flow.

Nora: Fingers on the deadlines? I need to tell the IC when it would show up in payroll.

hr-bot: Payroll cutoff reminder: submit by the 7th (inclusive) for next-month effective date. Late submissions go to the following payroll.

Diego (Comp): Also note: comp review turnaround is typically 3 business days for standard requests. If above-band or requires finance, expect longer (up to 2 weeks).

Ella (Eng): If we do a title now but delay salary, is that standard?

Diego (Comp): Yes, that's fine. Mark title-only in the title flow and submit a separate comp-change later, or include planned effective date for salary. Communicate both dates to the employee.

Nora: What about counteroffers? Manager wants to match an external offer next week.

Sam (People Ops): For counteroffers, submit the comp-change and include redacted offer docs. If urgent, flag "urgent" in the form and add manager rationale. Finance triages urgents but approvals still required.

Diego (Comp): If the proposed base exceeds band max, VP People + Finance approval required. If it's >20% over band max, exec approval likely.

Ella (Eng): Any tips to speed approvals?

Diego (Comp): Include market comps (3 data points), manager bullets on impact, and any retention risk evidence. Attach redacted offer if available.

Nora: If comp denied, do we have appeals?

Sam (People Ops): Managers can request re-review with additional info. For escalations ping me + Diego and include the form ticket ID.

hr-bot: Forms: comp-change: <https://redwood.internal/hr/comp-change-format> · title update: <https://redwood.internal/hr/title-update>. Batch CSV template: <https://redwood.internal/hr/comp-batch-template.csv>.

Nora: Perfect. I'll prep the form and loop you in for a pre-check.

Diego (Comp): Happy to pre-check.

Ella (Eng): Thanks 60; saving this for my managers.

Sam (People Ops): Quick reminder: equity refreshes and RSU grants require comp + legal review and follow quarterly grant windows.

Nora: Noted. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
